language.discrepancy_label: observed divergence from the reference path

ledger_update.rule: one appended row per update with its own known_at; the original forecast row is never rewritten; ForwardLedger has no public forecast amendment method, so the row is appended through the ledger's own locked append (declared deviation)

percent_withholding.denominator_rule: denominator_near_zero when |m0(H)| < denominator_near_zero_abs or |a(u) + g(u,H)| < denominator_near_zero_abs
percent_withholding.not_economically_meaningful_rule: not_economically_meaningful when |g(u,H)| < not_economically_meaningful_abs, or when a(u) / (a(u) + g(u,H)) < 0 (the observed path moved against the reference direction)
percent_withholding.rationale: Chosen before any fit from the units alone: 0.005 log return (about 50 bp) is the smallest denominator for which a ratio is not dominated by a single session's close noise on a broad ETF; 0.0025 (about 25 bp) is the scale of a round-trip trading cost plus a margin on the most liquid targets. Neither value was selected from a display example or a fitted outcome.
percent_withholding.sign_rule: sign_uncertain when the remaining interval straddles zero (low <= 0 <= high), or sign(m0(H)) != sign(g(u,H)), or sign(a(u) + g(u,H)) != sign(m0(H))

comparator_definitions.direct_state: DirectStateBaseline: the T15 direct-observable rung (ComponentBaseline or DirectFundingBaseline) refit at the elapsed cutoff u on the remaining-interval outcome; accepted only when model_version starts with glt_t15_component.v1 or glt_t15_direct_funding.v1 and ends with @<first 8 hex of the preregistration card_hash>
comparator_definitions.no_gap: NoGapComparator: g = 0 for every remaining interval
comparator_definitions.original_fixed: OriginalFixedResponse: g = m0(H) - m0(u) read from the T16 reference path

qualification.guard: every member's rows pass WindowGuard.admit(fold='dev') built from the preregistration card before the paired-population check; refused rows never enter any loss
qualification.loss: paired out-of-sample mean squared error of remaining-interval log returns log(P_H / P_u) on identical (shock_id, target_id, horizon_bdays) keys
qualification.rule: qualified only when candidate_mse <= margin * comparator_mse for EVERY comparator
qualification.significance: not tested in T18: the canonical HAC interface (engine.validation) is absent in this checkout; T20 owns significance and multiplicity

quantities.percent_complete: a(u) / (a(u) + g(u,H)), computed ONLY when the qualification passed and every withholding gate below is clear; otherwise null with a typed reason
quantities.reference_path_discrepancy: d(u) = m0(u) - a(u): the original reference path at the elapsed cutoff minus the observed cumulative return to that cutoff; a diagnostic about the path already travelled, labelled 'observed divergence from the reference path'
quantities.remaining_response_estimate: g(u,H) = E[log(P_H / P_u) | I_u]: set ONLY from a RemainderQualification that passed; never computed as m0(H) - a(u)
quantities.sign_function: sign(x) in {-1, 0, +1}; a zero sign never matches a non-zero sign

reference_path.exit_binding: m0(H) read from the path must equal the ledger forecast's expected_return within 1e-12
reference_path.interpolation: linear in elapsed sessions between grid horizons with m0(0) = 0; a read beyond the largest grid horizon or across a missing grid cell is refused
reference_path.model_version_binding: the ledger ForwardForecast.model_version must equal ledger_model_version(path.model_version): the path model_version lowercased with '+' replaced by '.' and '@' replaced by ':' (the contracts identifier grammar [a-z0-9_.:-] admits neither '+' nor '@')
reference_path.source: the T16 ResponsePath of the forecast's own model_version and target_id

thesis.eliminated: invalidating_information is non-empty (supplied by the caller from the docket; T18 discovers no events): remainder null with invalidated_by_new_information, H unchanged
thesis.expired: the ledger already holds a forecast_grade row for the forecast_key
thesis.horizon: the original exit H is immutable; any other exit argument raises HorizonExtensionError

units.definition: cumulative log return log(P_h / P_anchor) on the broad target card's total_return basis, quoted in USD; m0, a, d and g all share these units
